## Controller 1.0.51
### Android - **Sea Glass.** A new seafoam palette, and frosted glass that softens and bends the conversation behind the header, composer and approval cards. It's on by default; switch it off in Settings → Appearance to return to Controller blue. - Replies and code blocks are readable again in dark mode. - With the keyboard open, an approval card stays below the conversation header and scrolls inside itself.
### Mac and iPhone - The activity orb grows straight into its card and shrinks back into the orb in one smooth motion. - The context card opens and closes with the same water-drop motion as the model picker. - Codex 0.163: next-prompt suggestions, MCP sign-in results, network and permission details on command approvals, and model and effort on sub-agent rows. - OpenCode: send images, audio, video and PDFs to models that accept them. - Fixes a Mac hang while syncing preferences with iCloud, and cuts redundant sidebar, menu and titlebar redraws during background activity.

Controller 1.0.50 (60) ships unified macOS, iOS, Apple Watch, and Android updates.
- Morph the Mac New Thread palette and folder card out of the titlebar's New Thread and Add Project buttons with water-drop lens physics, and add elastic droplet staging and waist-pinch transitions to the reasoning effort card and model picker across macOS and iOS. - Adopt concentric corner geometry (`ConcentricRectangle`) across composer surfaces, model and effort cards, context usage cards, submission menus, task plan chips, and activity orb cards on iOS and macOS. - Show clear provider explanations when a turn is blocked by content moderation, token limits, or usage caps, and automatically continue recoverable Codex responses once when interrupted mid-turn. - Rebuild the Android model and reasoning effort picker as an inline Material 3 Expressive layered card with a continuous effort slider, Speed and option menus, and account rail, float the Android composer and inbox toolbar above the navigation bar and keyboard, draw reply Markdown and turn rows natively in Compose for smoother scrolling, and fix concurrent thread streaming.

Controller 1.0.50 (59) ships unified macOS, iOS, Apple Watch, and Android updates.
- Add `create_project` and cross-project / cross-Mac thread allocation so agents can create or clone project folders and start, follow, and message threads in other projects across connected Macs. - Add the optional experimental `terminal_passthrough` tool (`Settings → General` and `Settings → Connect`) to open, connect to, and control persistent pass-through terminal sessions and terminal tabs across connected Macs. - Add the `heartbeat` tool, `/heartbeat` slash command, and a live background scheduler for repeating and RFC 5545 `RRULE` automations that wake and refresh threads on schedule. - Add `watch_pull_request` (`watch_pr`) to monitor linked GitHub pull requests in the background and automatically wake the thread when new reviewer comments, review decisions, merge conflicts, or CI failures arrive. - Add Keychain-backed GitHub Personal Access Token management and browser OAuth sign-in in `Settings → Git`, expand `read_pull_request` comment excerpts, and fix model title overlap in the Mac picker search header and older-host OpenCode task report filtering.
